 ATEEZ makes history.
 SVO - ATEEZ made history by becoming the first K-pop idol group to perform at Deoksugung Palace, in the 'Immortal Songs' program.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 30/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On October 31st, the program Immortal Songs will air its 778th episode, the second part of the special series 'Royal Culture Festival 2026'. The group ATEEZ participated in this segment and prepared a special stage at Deoksugung Palace. There, they performed their recent hit, BAD, along with their new song, Drip, in a powerful performance befitting the majestic atmosphere of this historical site.
 This special program was filmed at Heungnyemun Square, within Gyeongbokgung Palace, as the opening event for the 'Royal Autumn Culture Festival'. This was also the first time the program held a performance at this location. The event attracted approximately 3,000 attendees, including around 300 international visitors. 
 You may also like Part two brings together artists from various genres, including Kim Chang Wan Band, Lyn, Lee Seung Gi, BOYNEXTDOOR, and NMIXX. NMIXX will perform "Blue Valentine" and "Heavy Serenade, " notably, their fan-recorded performance video at the palace garnered 3.9 million views even before the show officially aired. Meanwhile, BOYNEXTDOOR will energize the stage with their youthful energy through various songs, including " Animal ."
 Lee Seung Gi and Lyn will collaborate on a special ballad duet, while Kim Chang Wan Band will perform their classic hits. Additionally, a media facade light show covering Heungnyemun Square promises to create a spectacular visual feast for the evening.
 You may also like Previously, the first part of this special program aired on October 24th (episode 777 of Immortal Songs ), featuring artists such as xikers, Seo Eunkwang and Lee Minhyuk (BTOB), along with dancer Honey J. According to Nielsen Korea , this episode achieved a nationwide viewership rating of 5.3%, topping all entertainment programs broadcast on Saturdays.
 Part two of the special program 'Royal Culture Festival 2026' from Immortal Songs will air at 6:05 PM ( Korean time) on October 31st on KBS2.
